captured.how: Source lines read at the deployed refs below (checks/gen_contract_v2.py in the review directory); collection checked against the hub's name list at captured.at and the fixture pages in tests/fixtures/pages/.

statuses.emitted: The exporter at the deployed commit defines the metric; source names the file and line.
statuses.needs-source-change: A source change adds the metric: source.patch names it in source-patches/ (UNEXECUTED), or source.change names the branch that carries it.
statuses.planned: Defined here, with no source change written yet; the definition is the proposal.

collections.scraped: In the hub Prometheus today (its /api/v1/label/__name__/values at captured.at).
collections.not-scraped: The exporter serves it (a fixture page shows it), but no job of the lab's Prometheus scrapes the exporter; the v2 job of deploy/ does.
collections.dropped-at-ingestion: A lab job scrapes the exporter and its metric_relabel_configs keep list drops the metric; the v2 keep list of deploy/ keeps it.
collections.not-deployed: The source that emits it is not deployed on the labs.
collections.not-configured: The deployed exporter can emit it, but its configuration does not enable it.

stages.intent: Namespace intent: which namespaces CMTC selects for protection (controller).
stages.inventory: What the node agent observes on its node; never enforcement.
stages.enrollment: Capture and ZDS enrollment of a Pod into ztunnel, and the in-Pod proxies that serve it.
stages.identity: SPIRE identity: the workload certificates ztunnel fetches and the CA that signs them.
stages.admission: Policy sources: the callers the Cilium agent admits into effective plans, local and remote.
stages.publication: Effective plans published to ztunnel over xDS, and ztunnel's acknowledgment.
stages.release: Quarantine release of a Required workload once its plan is acknowledged.
stages.traffic: Connection outcomes: opened, failed by response flag, TLS handshakes, datapath drops.
stages.revocation: Certificate revocation (CRL) and policy narrowing reaching the datapath.
stages.trust: The issuer profile CMTC publishes and the approval it pins (ADR-010).
stages.pki: The mesh PKI of ADR-011: cert-manager Certificates and the trust-manager Bundle.
stages.dns: DNS: CoreDNS on the server side, the measurement plane on the client side.
stages.measurement: The observe-only eBPF measurement plane of ADR-005 (#36) itself.
stages.collection: The measurement pipeline: scrapes, remote write to the hub, alert evaluation.
stages.platform: Process and controller health of the mesh components: PIDs, reconcile errors, leadership.

cmtc-controller.owner: CMTC controller, Deployment cmtc-controller in cmtc-system (leader-elected)
cmtc-controller.endpoint: Pod port metrics (8080) /metrics over HTTP; NetworkPolicy cmtc-metrics admits only the monitoring namespaces (charts/cmtc/templates/networkpolicy.yaml)
cmtc-controller.notes: The API server's pod proxy cannot reach it (the NetworkPolicy admits no node), so its fixture is read back from the hub.

cmtc-node-agent.owner: CMTC node agent, DaemonSet cmtc-node-agent in cmtc-system
cmtc-node-agent.endpoint: Pod port metrics (8080) /metrics over HTTP, same NetworkPolicy
cmtc-node-agent.notes: Exports the measurement plane of #36 once that branch merges.

cilium-agent.owner: Cilium agent (fork), DaemonSet cilium in kube-system
cilium-agent.notes: The lab job keeps only cilium_ztunnel_.*|cmtc_.* (a hand patch, not in scripts/lab/monitoring.py) and labels the component cilium; the v2 job labels it cilium-agent.

ztunnel.endpoint: Pod IP port 15020 /stats/prometheus over HTTP (the container declares no port)
ztunnel.notes: scripts/lab/monitoring.py defines a ztunnel job; the live configuration of both labs has none.
